summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Agriculture to annually assess the United States' reliance on critical agricultural products and inputs from China, identify supply chain vulnerabilities, and recommend ways to reduce this dependency.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates the Secretary of Agriculture to conduct an annual assessment and submit reports to Congress. While it doesn't appropriate new funds, the act of conducting these assessments and generating recommendations will incur administrative costs for the Department of Agriculture, thus slightly increasing government spending.
